result:
All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked J1, J2, J7 and J11 by hand against the data. For the rest I only checked that the output looked right.

- **J13 and J14:** the J13 and J14 queries were each run only once.
- **J3:** it builds the name from `print` of the keyword key, which is fine for this file. A package name that needed quoting, such as a scoped `@types/x`, would break it.
- **J11:** it relies on `sort` being stable, which the tie between `/api/billing` and `/api/items` confirmed.

H1: /data | filter ~(and (/active | eq true) (coalesce ~(/address/city) ~(null) | type | eq ::string)) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
H2: filter ~(coalesce ~(/status | lower) ~("") | eq "paid") * (/items * mul /qty /price) | flat | sum | round 2
H3: :d (/devDependencies) | /dependencies | union d | :m (filter ~(startsWith "^")) | m | keys * (:n (print | drop 1) | :v (m | at n) | n | append "@" | append v)
H4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(coalesce ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count
H5: :d (/defaults) | /services | filter ~(coalesce ~(/enabled) ~(true) | eq true) | sort ~(/name) * {:name /name :timeout (coalesce ~(/timeout) ~(d | /timeout)) :retries (coalesce ~(/retries) ~(d | /retries))}
H6: filter ~(coalesce ~(/durationMs) ~(null) | type | eq ::number) | groupBy ~(/service) * (* /durationMs | :c (count) | :s (sum) | s | div c | round 1)
H7: filter ~(and (coalesce ~(/stock) ~(null) | type | eq ::number) (coalesce ~(/stock) ~(0) | gt 0)) | sort ~(/price) | reverse | take 3 * /name
H8: groupBy ~(/dept) * (* (coalesce ~(/skills) ~([])) | flat * lower | distinct | sort)
H9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~(and (/region | eq "eu-west") (/cpu/cores | gte 8))
H10: "Alice@Example.com, bob@test.org; carol@EXAMPLE.com, dave@mail.net; erin@Test.org, frank@example.com" | split "," * (split ";") | flat * (split "@" | at 1 | lower) | distinct | sort
H11: lines * (split " ") | filter ~(at 3 | gte "500") | groupBy ~(at 2) | vals * {:path (first | at 2) :count count} | sort ~(/path) | sort ~(/count | mul -1) | take 2
H12: lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(at 2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(at 1) * (* (at 2 | parseJson) | :c (count) | :s (sum) | s | div c | round 2)
H13: lines | filter ~(contains "==") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "==") | indexBy ~(at 0 | lower) * (at 1)
H14: sort ~(coalesce ~(/comments * (coalesce ~(/likes) ~(0)) | sum) ~(0)) | last | /title
